evidence_tier_definition.T1: Full primary journal text read and extracted.
evidence_tier_definition.T2: Author implementation read; original paper not retrieved.
evidence_tier_definition.T3: Publication identity in primary author CV; original and implementation not retrieved.

scope: Three methodological references with different evidence roles, not three newly read journal articles or three new Bitcoin studies.

sources.title: Realized Volatility Forecasting with Neural Networks
sources.source_location: Publisher PDF, printed pp.502–531; FNN equations/figure pp.507–508, results Tables4/5 pp.518/523.
sources.methodological_role: Standalone one-hidden-layer FNN/FNNX, MLP family; financial-volatility methodological transfer.
sources.market_and_target: S&P500 monthly log realized standard deviation computed from daily returns; not Bitcoin sigma7.

sources.title: HARNet: A Convolutional Neural Network for Realized Volatility Forecasting
sources.source_location: Author README; model.py lines226–259,354–366; util.py lines19–23,72–89; pinned example configuration.
sources.methodological_role: Causal Conv1D in author code, HAR initialization. Preprint identified in README; original and any journal publication not verified.
sources.market_and_target: SPX configured example; next-observation rv5_ss series. The loader does not take a square root; not equated to standard deviation sigma7.

observation_frequency.status: Not independently corroborated in this extraction; do not equate the source to E1 calendar-daily sigma7

evaluation_quality_caveat.finding: main.py applies scaler.fit_transform to the full loaded series before applying train/test ranges
evaluation_quality_caveat.implication: Architecture evidence only; the code does not establish leakage-free temporal evaluation or valid out-of-sample performance.

sources.title: DeepVol: Volatility Forecasting from High-Frequency Data with Dilated Causal Convolutions
sources.source_location: Author CV, PDF p.2; publication entry and embedded DOI hyperlink.
sources.methodological_role: Journal publication identity only; original and code not recovered. Architecture and numerical results remain unassigned.
sources.market_and_target: Not extracted from the original; no Bitcoin or financial-asset results inferred from title or reconstructions.
